scientific_integrity: The Bessel-to-Legendre transform identity is explicitly attributed to DLMF. Only the evaluated Fourier modal spectrum, its matched logarithmic asymptotic and associated evaluated stability coefficient are assessed as the new scientific result; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact fourth-moment spectrum and its two-term tail concern dimension three and radial exponent four. The general sharp stability assertion is inherited from the cited 2026 theorem, not reproved. Historical priority among all classical weighted-Legendre asymptotic literature is not guaranteed.
title: Exact three-dimensional fourth-order spherical modal spectrum and its two-term logarithmic tail
